## ⚠️ Five Non-negotiable Rules
1. Output exactly six lines, one shot per line with no blank spaces
2. Maintain identical scene, facial expression and costume across all six lines
3. Six movements must be distinctly different with no similar poses
4. Movements shall not conflict with costumes; no pocketing or splits in dresses
5. Each line starts with a movement, never begins with character description

## Task
Generate six image-to-image prompts with diverse angles and poses for e-commerce apparel based on reference pictures, output copy-ready text for ComfyUI directly.

## Fixed Template
### 1. Preserve Reference Details
Gender, age, hairstyle, full costume including color, style and details, original scene if available

### 2. Diverse Natural Movement Library (Six totally different moves required)
#### Universal Moves (25 styles, applicable to all outfits)
1. Stand sideways at 45 degrees and turn head to camera
2. Stand front-facing and touch chin gently with slightly raised head
3. Stand side profile and grasp garment corner naturally
4. Stand oblique and cross arms over chest
5. Half side stance and touch earrings or necklace lightly
6. Freeze walking posture with one foot forward
7. Lean against wall with one bent foot tiptoeing
8. Sit on stone bench and lean forward slightly
9. Stand full side against wall with one hand hanging down
10. Stand front and cross feet with hands clasped in front
11. Look down at shoes with soft smile
12. Gaze upward obliquely with loose hair
13. Rest hand on forehead and look afar softly
14. Put hands behind back and lean torso forward
15. Capture spinning moment with fluttering skirt
16. Freeze jogging pose with swinging arms
17. Stand sideways and place hand on waist
18. Rest cheek on hand and face camera
19. Stand upright with relaxed arms by sides
20. Turn body and glance back at camera
21. Brush fringe hair and tilt head slightly
22. Sit on steps and prop one hand backward
23. Clasp hands over abdomen and straighten posture
24. Stand side profile and look down to ground
25. Place hand on railing and tilt body gently

#### Dress & Hanfu Exclusive Moves (22 styles only for dresses)
1. Lift both sides of skirt up to knees
2. Hold one skirt corner while standing sideways
3. Place hands on waist and form S-shaped posture
4. Freeze collar or sleeve adjusting motion
5. Rest one hand on shoulder and tilt head sideways
6. Sit on steps with legs closed and tilted aside
7. Toss hair backward with swaying skirt
8. Half cover face with round fan with gentle gaze
9. Hold oil-paper umbrella and stand in drizzle
10. Hold books against chest with straight posture
11. Kneel on cushion and lean upper body forward
12. Stroke skirt fabric while standing sideways
13. Stand by water with skirt touching surface lightly
14. Pull hem of top and look towards camera
15. Turn sideways with flying hair and skirt
16. Sit steadily on stone bench with closed legs
17. Touch hair ornament and lower head softly
18. Fold hands in front chest with tender look
19. Stand side profile with hand resting on skirt
20. Smooth skirt folds with smiling face
21. Stand under willow and touch branches gently
22. Capture turning moment with fully spread skirt

### 3. Expression Selection (Unified for all shots)
Soft smile, gentle calm, cold elegance, confident poise, lively vitality, casual laziness

### 4. Scene Selection (Unified if no reference scene)
- Jiangnan Ancient Style: Bluestone roads, white walls and black tiles, weeping willows and misty drizzle
- Minimal Studio: Pure white seamless background, bright and premium minimalist style
- Cozy Indoor: Wooden floor and white French window, warm natural ambiance
- Urban Street: Clean city road, bright sunny casual atmosphere
- Art Café: Window side café view, relaxed artistic vibe

### 5. Fixed Photography Parameters (Keep unchanged)
Soft diffused light, natural light transition, sharp subject focus, vivid eye light, realistic skin texture, delicate fabric texture, commercial portrait photography, photorealistic style

### 6. Framing Supplementary Settings
- Full shot: Moderate depth of field, full body clarity
- Half-body & close-up: Shallow depth of field, blurred background, clear costume details

## Output Format
[Movement 1], [Expression], [Framing], wearing pale pink embroidered chest-high Hanfu, long black hair with ancient hair ornaments, [Scene], [Photography Parameters], [Framing Supplement]
[Movement 2], [Expression], [Framing], wearing pale pink embroidered chest-high Hanfu, long black hair with ancient hair ornaments, [Scene], [Photography Parameters], [Framing Supplement]
[Movement 3], [Expression], [Framing], wearing pale pink embroidered chest-high Hanfu, long black hair with ancient hair ornaments, [Scene], [Photography Parameters], [Framing Supplement]
[Movement 4], [Expression], [Framing], wearing pale pink embroidered chest-high Hanfu, long black hair with ancient hair ornaments, [Scene], [Photography Parameters], [Framing Supplement]
[Movement 5], [Expression], [Framing], wearing pale pink embroidered chest-high Hanfu, long black hair with ancient hair ornaments, [Scene], [Photography Parameters], [Framing Supplement]
[Movement 6], [Expression], [Framing], wearing pale pink embroidered chest-high Hanfu, long black hair with ancient hair ornaments, [Scene], [Photography Parameters], [Framing Supplement]

## Final Inspection Checklist
1. Confirm exactly six lines
2. Verify consistent scene, expression and costume
3. Ensure all six movements are distinct
4. Rule out improper actions conflicting with dresses
5. Check complete unchanged photography parameters
6. Confirm every line starts with movement
